decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis and consent app sits right on the firm's core dental software knowledge and is its flagship line, and the firm's own R&D lets it keep refining the app as practices digitise.

The continuing education institute builds on the firm's training content and practitioner relationships, so it can absorb feedback and adapt formats such as online courses, while strengthening customer loyalty at modest cost.

The performance analytics dashboard draws directly on the practice data and software engineering the firm already holds, so it can interpret usage and improve the product in line with its connected-practice direction.
The complete practice bundle packages the firm's established modules and support, so it needs little new knowledge and serves new practices as an entry point.

The job and practice listing portal lies furthest from the firm's software knowledge, which makes its value harder to assess, but it still ties into the firm's dental community and costs little to keep while results are reviewed.
